name: Hatano
source:
[url=/c12955]Kenji[/url]’s friend and classmate who serves as the comic relief guy in the story. He has a crush on Kenji's older cousin, [url=/c6469]Hikari[/url], and tries to make a move on her but only ends up getting dumped. He would do anything for her to the point of becoming her slave.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
